title: CFCEval: Evaluating Security Aspects in Code Generated by Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Applying semantic-preserving code perturbations (such as variable renaming, if-condition flipping, and structural refactoring) to vulnerability instances to create distributionally shifted test data. The models are then evaluated on their 'Post-Transformation Fixing Capability' to distinguish between true generalization and artificial performance inflation caused by memorizing the training data.
